api_list.name: Data Events

required_parameters.name: list_type
required_parameters.description: Way of formation of a conclusion. There may be two kinds: sub - events will be as sub-items of tournaments. list - all items are displayed, simply by a common list.

required_parameters.name: sport_id
required_parameters.description: sport ID, if ID = 0, all matches for all sports will be returning

required_parameters.name: tournament_id
required_parameters.description: tournament ID, if ID = 0, all matches for all tournament will be returning

required_parameters.name: page_length
required_parameters.description: Number of events in answer.It must be a multiple of five. If it 's not like that. That, the system itself will occlude it to the greater side of the multiplicity.
